title: WPSS/1540/2022 of KALPANA NEGI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No. 1540 of 2022
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
Mr. Navnish Negi, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. V.S. Rawat, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand/ respondents.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Petitioner is serving as Assistant
Teacher in Government Primary School in
Block Khirsu, District Pauri Garhwal. She has
been transferred to Government Prim ary
School, Pasol, within the same district vide
order dated 08.07.2022.
Petitioner has challenged the said
transfer order, mainly on the ground that, she
had indicated 10 places in her option, given
pursuant to Section 9 of Uttarakhand Annual
Transfer for Public Servants Act, 2017,
however, the places indicated in her option,
were not considered and petitioner has been
transferred to som e other place.
Learned counsel for petitioner points out
that places indicated at serial nos. 3, 4 & 5 of
petitioners option, are still vacant, and
petitioner can very well be adjusted in any of
those schools. He further points out that all
those three schools are Durgam.
Learned State Counsel very fairly
submits that since petitioner has made a

representation, the same shall be decided
expeditiously.
Since petitioner's representation is
pending before the Com petent Authority,
therefore, writ petition is disposed of by
directing the Com petent Authority to
consider petitioner's representation and
take appropriate decision, as per law, within
two weeks from today. I t shall be open to
petitioner to subm it soft copy of this order
with soft copy of representation through
e-m ail on or before 06.08.2022.
For a period of two weeks or till decision
is taken on petitioner's representation,
whichever is earlier, status quo, qua
petitioner's posting shall be maintained.

( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
 04.08.2022
Navin
